name: Early 20s rebound
description: A side trades in the 20s during the first five minutes and you buy that same side.

name: Teens comeback
description: A side trades in the teens and you buy that same side.

name: Single-digit resurrection
description: A side trades below 10 cents and you buy that same side.

name: 30s recovery
description: A side trades in the 30s and you study its rebound path from there.

name: Full flip from 10s
description: A side trades at 10 cents or lower and you track whether it later becomes the favorite.

name: Favorite fade from 80s
description: A side trades at 80 to 90 cents in the first three minutes and you buy the opposite side.

name: Favorite fade from 70s
description: A side trades at 70 to 79 cents and you buy the opposite side.

name: Favorite fade from 90s
description: A side trades at 90 cents or higher and you buy the opposite side.

name: Full flip from 20s
description: A side trades at 20 cents or lower and you buy that same side looking for a full flip.

name: Full flip from 30s
description: A side trades at 30 cents or lower and you track whether it later clears 50 cents.

name: Late underdog comeback
description: A side trades at 20 cents or lower with three minutes or less remaining and you buy that side.

name: Ultra-late single digits
description: A side trades at 10 cents or lower with under one minute remaining.
